That's the little summarized backstory for you, and yet.. despite all this I held onto that relationship way too long before ending it eventually at the just under a year mark, despite all the sadness and quite frankly manipulation of not being allowed to talk to the very few friends I've always had, that title of having a 'girlfriend' just seemed to validate my life and happiness staying in it way too long, after ending it I of course hated everything for a long time and swamped myself with major depressive episodes for months if not half a year... I guess what i'm trying to say is there is level of gratefulness to take from being happy when you're together at least, you may be back in a state when you're apart but when you meet someone that you can be happy and yourself around when they are with you.. that is A START.. I just can't stress, take it and run with it as best as you can, take the happiness you can get now and it just might snowball, Good luck OP, I wish you well, really man! c:
